purpose: Agent-facing contract for registration candidate packages and architect assessment artifacts.

field_rules.previous_registration_ref: null or the exact prior package reference supplied by Maestro
field_rules.content_hash: SHA-256 calculated by the content_hash rule below
field_rules.files: one inventory entry for every candidate record; the manifest does not list itself

scope_boundary.rule: The summary, milestone set, milestone dependencies, and completion requirements must exactly implement the supplied immutable boundary. Do not reinterpret or expand it.

fields.record_id: nonempty text unique across the candidate
fields.subject: nonempty plain-language text
fields.data: the exact object defined for the record type

rules: scope has exactly included and excluded text arrays matching the confirmed scope boundary
assessment_outcome is ready, clarification_required, or blocked
designation, record type, and prefix entries each contain code and subject
assignment and run identify the current Maestro-created architect run
review identity and accounting are supplied by Maestro
local references must exactly match an inventoried candidate record
external references must use the assigned source repository, exact source commit, and inventoried source path

hashing.record_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON: keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8, and no NaN values
hashing.content_hash: Sort every non-review record by path. For each, append path, one tab, its record SHA-256, and one newline. SHA-256 the resulting UTF-8 bytes.
hashing.candidate_reference_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact manifest bytes written to output/candidate/manifest.json

assessment_artifact.rule: It must describe the same exact source, decision version, findings, and candidate returned in the response.

package_rules: Use only safe relative paths with no parent traversal.
Use one summary and one naming-conventions record at their fixed paths.
Include at least one declaration, milestone, requirement, assessment, and decision; a ready reviewed package also has exactly one current review.
Preserve exact supplied declaration identity, version, subject, outcome identity, version, subject, and order for the confirmed scope.
Include the service-owned selection decision identified by instructions and do not change its authority.
Do not create development milestones, work packets, activation claims, or broader scope.
